stated.outline: a broad flat-topped open umbrella of separate needle masses on a long bare trunk
stated.habit: open-grown mature tree 20 to 30 m tall, crown spread 8 to 12 m; height about 1.5 to 2 times the crown's width. Crown the top 55 to 60 % of the height; a clean bole for about 40 to 45 %, as the anchor picture and the side view show (measured on their black masks). Widest near the top third. Outline a broad flat-topped open umbrella of separate needle masses on a long bare trunk. One trunk.
stated.branching: whorled when young; on old trees a few wide crooked limbs, nearly level, with upturned tufted ends. Four orders.
stated.leaves: exactly two per sheath, 4 to 7 cm, twisted, stiff, blue-green, about twenty times as long as thick, spreading in a narrow V.
